title: Column axial force: ASCE 7-22 strength combinations with roof and snow loads

rubric.text: The response should use the ASCE 7-22 snow factors (1.0S where snow is the principal load, 0.3S as a companion, with pf as the companion value), find that 1.2D + 1.6L + 0.5Lr governs the maximum and 0.9D - 1.0W the minimum.
